newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco says telecoms need overhaul, investments.
newsitem.headline: Morocco says telecoms need overhaul, investments.

text.p: Morocco's telecommunications sector needs urgent reform and privatisation to be competitive in the world marketplace, King Hassan was quoted as saying.

"In the telecommunications sector, the reform of its institutional framework is inevitable because of the requirements of increasing liberalisation of the world market." Morocco's RTM radio on Tuesday quoted the king as saying.

"To integrate in the world economy, it is necessary to turn to a better performing telecommunication network which requires huge investments which the state cannot afford...It is urgently needed to call on private initiatives to support the public sector efforts," King Hassan added.
Morocco's parliament is expected soon to adopt a law to partly privatise the telecommunications sector, officials said.

South Korean giant Daewoo, the U.S. AT&T and French Alcatel have shown interest in the privatisation of the GSM system, the finance ministry has said. Daewoo plans to spend $100 million, out of a total of $900 million investment, to modernise the GSM network.
With its 27 million population, Morocco has a teledensity of four lines for 100 inhabitans including 30,000 GSM subscribers, according to officials.
